'''Argazda''' was the [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdan]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], local Provisional [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Myrial]] and her followers the [[Myrialites]] rebelled against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], establishing the [[Argazdan Redoubt]]. They conquered neighboring [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] throughout the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]], including [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]]. These events were known as the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]], lasting from [[3970 BBY]]&ndash;[[3670 BBY]]. This conflict resulted in the deaths of more than five billion until combined Republic/[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] efforts under [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mari-Elan Nora]] overthrew the Myrialites.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space. Later, during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Argazda surrendered to the [[extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders as they swept through the Outer Rim.<ref name="TEA" />
